% =====================================================================
%  SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every number quoted in the proposal.
%  The exec summary, glance panel, tables and text all read these macros,
%  so they can never disagree. Replace \dbftbd{...} with the value once
%  the analysis produces it (later: generated by the analysis scripts).
%  Units are SI (team decision, 11 Oct 2026): m, kg, s, m/s, Wh.
%  Rule limits are quoted with their US value in parentheses where the
%  rules define them. Scoring rounds to 2 decimals in s, in, oz, lb
%  (rules Sec. 6.2), but score ratios are unit-free. The GM drop height
%  is declared in whole inches: use 0.0254-m steps (1.524 m = 60 in).
%  Macro names keep "Weight" for continuity; the values are masses (kg).
% =====================================================================

% --- Aircraft -----------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nSpan{\dbftbd{span}}                 % m   (rule: <= 1.829 = 6 ft)
\newcommand\nWingArea{\dbftbd{S}}                % m^2
\newcommand\nAR{\dbftbd{AR}}
\newcommand\nEmptyWeight{\dbftbd{m empty}}       % kg
\newcommand\nGrossMtwo{\dbftbd{TOGW M2}}         % kg  (rule: < 24.95 = 55 lb)
\newcommand\nGrossMthree{\dbftbd{TOGW M3}}       % kg
\newcommand\nBatteryWh{\dbftbd{Wh}}              % Wh  (rule: <= 100 total)
\newcommand\nCruise{\dbftbd{V cruise}}           % m/s
\newcommand\nLapTime{\dbftbd{lap time}}          % s

% --- Sensor / container -------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nSensorWeight{\dbftbd{m sensor}}     % kg (max declared)
\newcommand\nSensorLength{\dbftbd{L sensor}}     % mm (rule: >= 152.4 = 6 in)
\newcommand\nTowLength{\dbftbd{tow length}}      % m  (rule: >= 1.5 x actual span)
\newcommand\nContainerWeight{\dbftbd{m container}} % kg

% --- Mission targets ----------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\nMtwoUnits{\dbftbd{units}}           % container + simulators
\newcommand\nMtwoPayload{\dbftbd{m payload}}     % kg
\newcommand\nMtwoTime{\dbftbd{5-lap time}}       % s
\newcommand\nMthreeLaps{\dbftbd{laps}}
\newcommand\nDropHeight{\dbftbd{h}}              % m  (rule: <= 1.524 = 60 in, whole inches)

% --- Predicted scores ---------------------------------------------------
\newcommand\sMone{1.00}
\newcommand\sMtwo{\dbftbd{M2}}
\newcommand\sMthree{\dbftbd{M3}}
\newcommand\sGM{\dbftbd{GM}}
\newcommand\sTotal{\dbftbd{total}}               % of 7.50
